*  We have number of UI test cases to evaluate the run-time behavior of the system on the functional requirement. 

 ===Requirement:===
 

  *   You will need [http://www.eclipse.org/swtbot/downloads.php SWTBOT] for UI Testing.
  *   And the plugin(org.unicase.ui.test) itself, which you can checkout from the repository along with the other plugin(org.unicase.workspace.test) on which the test plugin is dependent.
